Court Allows Cockroach Janata Party Protest March in Delhi

The Supreme Court of India has permitted the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) to proceed with its protest march scheduled for September 5 in Delhi. Chief Justice Surya Kant made the observation regarding the protest. The CJP's national spokesperson was welcomed at CCSU, with a call for students to join the Delhi protest.
